about_the_game:
Enhance Digimon Story Time Stranger with special outer dungeons.

Outer Dungeons include:
• The Hall of EXP: Obtain experience items by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon
• The Hall of Gold: Obtain in-game currency by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon
• The Hall of Materials: Obtain materials for Farm Items by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon

*Outer Dungeons can be accessed through the The In-Between Theater.
